newsitem.title: UK: Daimler may consider full-year dividend.
newsitem.headline: Daimler may consider full-year dividend.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG chairman Juergen Schrempp said the company might pay shareholders a dividend at the full-year stage if a positive earnings trend continues into the second half.
"If the second half continues along the same path or slightly better, the answer is obvious," Schrempp told a news conference.
"We will go back to discuss dividends," he added.

Daimler-Benz paid no dividend in 1995 when it reported a 5.7 billion mark loss. However, the conglomerate returned to the black in the first half of 1996, when it posted a net profit of 782 million marks compared with a 1.57 billion loss in 1995's first half.
